import os
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))


class DoctorMaskTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_secrets_are_masked_and_source_shown(self):
        import tempfile
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            result = subprocess.run(
                [sys.executable, "-m", "payhook", "doctor"],
                cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True,
                env={**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": ROOT,
                     "PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN": "supersecrettoken1234"},
            )
        self.assertNotIn("supersecrettoken", result.stdout)
        self.assertIn("****1234  [env]", result.stdout)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_REGION = eu  [default]", result.stdout)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
EOF
